import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storyline/claimChest/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 领取宝箱指令
 * /领取宝箱 {章节} {宝箱序号}  → 领取指定宝箱
 * /领取宝箱 {章节}             → 一键领取该章所有可领取宝箱
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const m = e.MessageText.trim().match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?领取宝箱\s+(\d+)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);

    if (!m) {
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      errMd.addText('❌ 参数错误');
      errMd.addNewline();
      errMd.addText('使用方法：/领取宝箱 章节 宝箱序号');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
          bid,
          title: '宝箱',
          header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/副本列表' }],
          content: errMd
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const chapterNumber = Number(m[2]);
    const chestIndex = m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : null;

    const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
    const result = await App({ uid, bid, chapterNumber, chestIndex, request });

    if (result.code === 'INVALID_PARAMS') {
      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      throw new Error(result.data.message);
    }

    const resultMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (result.data.success) {
      resultMd.addText(`🎁 ${result.data.message}`);

      if (result.data.claimedIndexes.length > 0) {
        resultMd.addNewline();
        resultMd.addNewline();

        for (const idx of result.data.claimedIndexes) {
          resultMd.addText(`✅ 宝箱${idx} 已领取`);
          resultMd.addNewline();
        }
      }
    } else {
      const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, '领取宝箱', `❌ ${result.data.message}`, request);

      resultMd.addText(failMsg);
    }

    if (result.data.chests.length > 0) {
      resultMd.addNewline();
      resultMd.addText(`第${chapterNumber}章宝箱状态`);
      resultMd.addNewline();

      for (const chest of result.data.chests) {
        if (chest.claimed) {
          resultMd.addText(`🎁(${chest.requiredStars}⭐)：灵晶×${chest.reward} ✅`);
          resultMd.addNewline();
        } else if (chest.unlocked) {
          resultMd.addText(`🎁(${chest.requiredStars}⭐)：灵晶×${chest.reward} 🔓`);

          addOptions(resultMd, [{ label: '领取', command: `/领取宝箱 ${chapterNumber} ${chest.index}` }]);
        } else {
          resultMd.addText(`🎁(${chest.requiredStars}⭐)：灵晶×${chest.reward} 🔒`);
          resultMd.addNewline();
        }
      }
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
        bid,
        title: `第${chapterNumber}章宝箱`,
        header: [
          { label: '返回', command: `/查看主线 ${chapterNumber}` },
          { label: '副本', command: '/副本列表' }
        ],
        content: resultMd
      })
    );
  } catch (_error) {
    logger.error('领取宝箱失败:', _error);

    const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    errMd.addText('❌ 领取宝箱失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false,
        bid,
        title: '宝箱',
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/副本列表' }],
        content: errMd
      })
    );
  }
});
